variantes: Call completed. Audio was clear on both ends and no interpretation issues came up.
Session ended normally. No terminology or connection concerns during the call.
Interpretation completed without incident. Both parties confirmed understanding before disconnecting.
Call handled to completion. No clarifications were required and no technical problems occurred.
Assignment finished normally. Communication flowed without interruptions on either side.
Call concluded as expected. Nothing to flag regarding audio, terminology or conduct.

AUDIO.nota: Se escucha mal, ruido, eco, volumen bajo
variantes: Audio quality was poor on the LEP side. Repetition was requested several times to confirm information.
Persistent background noise made portions of the call hard to hear. Interpreter asked for clarification when needed.
Volume on the requester's line was very low. Interpreter asked the party to repeat on multiple occasions.
Intermittent echo throughout the call affected comprehension. All content was ultimately conveyed.
Audio broke up at several points. Interpreter notified both parties and requested repetition.
Speaker was difficult to hear due to distance from the microphone. Interpreter requested repetition to ensure accuracy.

RED.nota: Se cortó la conexión, no fue decisión de nadie
variantes: Connection dropped mid-session. The call did not reconnect on the interpreter's line.
Line disconnected unexpectedly while the call was in progress. Interpreter remained available for reconnection.
Unstable connection caused repeated cut-outs until the call was lost.
Session ended abruptly due to a connection failure, not by either party.
The platform disconnected the call before the conversation was completed.
Call was lost during the exchange. Interpreter stayed on the line briefly in case of reconnection.
Interpreter connected and announced, but no other party joined the line.
Call connected with silence on both ends. No response after repeated announcements.
Interpreter waited on the line; neither the requester nor the LEP was present.
Connected to an empty line. Interpreter announced in both languages and received no reply.
No participants on the call after connection. Interpreter disconnected per protocol.
Line was open but unattended. Interpreter announced twice before ending the session.

COLGO.nota: Una de las partes cortó antes de terminar
variantes: The LEP disconnected before the conversation was completed.
Requester ended the call while the exchange was still in progress.
One of the parties hung up mid-session without closing the conversation.
Call was terminated by the caller before the interpretation could be finished.
The party disconnected immediately after the interpreter announced. No content was exchanged.
Session ended by the requester once the information had been relayed, before formal closing.

IDIOMA.nota: La parte no habla el idioma solicitado
variantes: The party spoke a language other than the one requested. Interpreter advised the requester and the call was ended.
Language mismatch on the call: the LEP did not speak Spanish. Requester was informed.
Interpreter was connected for Spanish, but the speaker required a different language. Requester was notified.
The LEP did not respond to Spanish. Interpreter advised the requester to request the correct language line.
Requested language did not match the speaker's language. Call was released so the correct interpreter could be assigned.

TRANSF.nota: Pasaron la llamada a otra área
variantes: Call was transferred to another department mid-session. Interpreter continued through the handoff.
Requester placed the call on hold and transferred it. Interpretation resumed with the receiving agent.
Session included a transfer to a specialized unit. No issues during the handoff.
Call moved to a second representative. Interpreter remained on the line throughout.
The requester escalated the call to a supervisor. Interpretation continued without interruption.
Specialized terminology required clarification. Interpreter requested an explanation and conveyed it accurately.
Technical vocabulary came up during the call. Interpreter asked the speaker to clarify before rendering.
Interpreter requested clarification on an acronym used by the requester to ensure accurate rendition.
Call included medical terminology unfamiliar in context. Interpreter confirmed meaning before continuing.
A regional expression required confirmation. Interpreter checked with the speaker and rendered accordingly.
Extended hold time during the session. Interpreter remained on the line until the party returned.
Requester placed the call on hold for a prolonged period before resuming the conversation.
Most of the session was spent on hold. Actual interpretation time was brief.
Interpreter waited on hold while the requester retrieved information. Call resumed normally afterward.
